case_title: ARVIND KUMAR @ NEMICHAND & ORS. v. STATE OF RAJASTHAN
trial_court_outcome: Acquittal of two, conviction of five
high_court_outcome: Acquittal of one more accused, conviction of other four
neutral_facts: The case involves a dispute between two groups of villagers over a pathway. The prime accused, along with his son and 25 others, entered the land of the victim and other witnesses and attacked them with weapons, resulting in the death of two and injuries to others. An eyewitness filed a complaint, leading to the acquittal of two and conviction of five. The High Court acquitted one more accused while upholding the conviction of the other four. The Supreme Court found the evidence insufficient and the investigation flawed, leading to the acquittal of all accused. The case was initially a civil dispute that turned into a criminal case due to the use of weapons and the resulting deaths.
